headline: Read Airthings sensors over Bluetooth
intro: Connect a supported Airthings device to Home Assistant over Bluetooth LE and add sensor entities according to its model. Devices need Bluetooth connectivity, current firmware, and range of the Home Assistant host or a Bluetooth proxy that supports active connections.
highlights: Monitor readings such as humidity, illuminance, pressure, radon, temperature, VOC, CO2, and battery where the device provides them
Support Wave Gen. 1, Wave Radon, Wave Mini, Wave Plus, Wave Enhance, and Corentium Home 2
Use Bluetooth connectivity; devices configured for SmartLink do not provide live readings to Home Assistant over Bluetooth

flow.title: From Airthings device to Home Assistant sensors
stages: Enable Bluetooth and ensure the device is within range of the host or an active-connection Bluetooth proxy
Update device firmware in the Airthings app and switch connectivity from SmartLink to Bluetooth if needed
Add Airthings BLE from Settings → Devices & services and follow the on-screen setup
Review the sensor entities available for the device model
